title: daviesia benthamii subsp. acanthoclona
intro: Daviesia benthamii subsp. acanthoclona, commonly known as Spiny Bitter Pea, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in Australian herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiny Bitter Pea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects. Studies have identified several bioactive compounds present in the plant, including daviesin, which may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
